title: Linx Saber Portable Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
Introducing the Linx Saber Vaporizer, the latest innovation in dry herb vaporizers from Linx Vapor. This device offers impressive vapor production and easy handling, making it a great dry herb vaporizer for beginners—all at an incredibly affordable price!

Integrated glass mouthpiece and chamber.
Replaceable heating coil.
Four preset temperatures.
Toxin-free airpath.
2200mAH large capacity battery.
Metal casing

FULL FEATURES
True Convection Heating
Replaceable Heating Coil
Integrated glass mouthpiece and chamber
Compatible with Linx glass bubbler
Four temperature
Budget friendly
Metal Casing
Toxin Free Materials
2200mAH large capacity battery.
Dimension: 8 inch (height) x 1 inch (diameter)
Weight: 3.52 oz (100g)

Includes
1 Linx Saber vaporizer
1 Integrated Glass Mouthpiece & Chamber
1 Type C Charging Cable
1 Cleaning Brush
4 Silicone Rings
1 User Manuel

FOUR TEMPS
Achieve your ideal temperature in just 30 seconds with four temperature settings for full, rich clouds on demand.

CONSERVE FLAVOR
The novel design of inserting the heating element directly into the ground material ensures true convection heating, preserving terpenes and cannabinoids for a smooth, clean vapor.

REPLACEABLE HEATING COIL
Linx Saber sets itself apart with a replaceable heating coil—a cost-saving feature most rivals don’t offer. By replacing just the coil, which tends to wear out faster, you can extend the life of your vaporizer.

MASSIVE CLOUDS
The innovative design combines the heating element with the glass mouthpiece and chamber, ensuring even hot air flow for substantial vapor production and exceptional flavor.

Tip 1 – Pack loosely Convection heating uses the airflow from you pulling o the device to circulate hot air inside the chamber. Make sure not to overfill as this heating method needs room for the heat to transfer.

Tip 2 – Take long steady draws Proper draws allow time for hot air to flow through your dry herb and deliver the best flavorful clouds.

Tip 3 – Grind the herb to a medium fine consistency Avoid grinding the her too finely to prevent blocking the vaporizer’s air holes.
